name: PEKAT
recent: Pekat Group 获得证券监督委员会批准转板至主板，并通过间接持股60%的子公司以约3,058万令吉收购六块工业地。公司同时延长了私募配售所得款项的使用期限，并有多名董事及高管在公开市场售股。
notable: 获得证券监督委员会批准，将股票转板至 Bursa Malaysia 主板。
间接持股60%的子公司 EPE Switchgear 以约3,058万令吉收购六块永久工业地。
延长私募配售所得款项的使用期限。
risks: 董事 Datin Shelina Binti Razaly Wahi 于2026年10月6日出售20,000股。
首席财务官 Oh Keng Jin 于2026年9月29日出售300,000股。
公司延长私募配售所得款项使用期限，显示部分资金尚未按原定计划使用。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为1.754亿令吉，环比增长4.5%，同比增长38.1%；净利为1,419万令吉，环比增长14.2%，同比增长28.8%；净利率为8.1%，高于上一季度的7.4%。

recent_en: Pekat Group received SC approval to transfer to the Main Market and is acquiring six industrial land parcels for about RM30.6 million through an indirect 60%-owned subsidiary. The company also extended the timeframe for using its private placement proceeds, while several directors and a senior officer sold shares in the open market.
notable_en: Received SC approval to transfer its listing to the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia.
Indirect 60%-owned subsidiary EPE Switchgear is acquiring six freehold industrial land parcels for about RM30.6 million.
Extended the timeframe for utilising proceeds from its private placement exercise.
risks_en: Director Datin Shelina Binti Razaly Wahi disposed of 20,000 shares on 6 October 2026.
Chief Financial Officer Oh Keng Jin disposed of 300,000 shares on 29 September 2026.
The company extended the timeframe for using its private placement proceeds, indicating some funds have not been used as originally scheduled.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM175.4 million, up 4.5% QoQ and 38.1% YoY; net income was RM14.2 million, up 14.2% QoQ and 28.8% YoY; net margin was 8.1%, higher than 7.4% in the previous quarter.
